title: Terms of Service
intro: These terms govern your use of the {{appName}} app. Please read them. Last updated {{updated}}.

sections.heading: 1. Agreement
paragraphs: By creating an account or using {{appName}} you agree to these terms and to our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, do not use the app.

sections.heading: 2. What the app does
paragraphs: {{appName}} lets you build a basket of grocery items and compare estimated prices at nearby stores. It is an information service only. You do not buy anything through the app, and we are not a retailer.

sections.heading: 3. Prices and accuracy
paragraphs: Prices, product details, images, and store information come from the websites of the retailers shown in the app (for example metro.ca, foodbasics.ca, and walmart.ca) and are collected periodically. They may be out of date, incomplete, or different from what you see in a store or on a retailer's website, and items may be out of stock. Treat all results as estimates and confirm the price with the retailer before you rely on it. We do not guarantee that any store is the cheapest or that any total is exact.

sections.heading: 4. No affiliation with retailers
paragraphs: {{appName}} is independent. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by any grocery retailer. Retailer and product names are used only to identify them, and belong to their respective owners. The prices, product details, and images shown in the app are the retailers' information from their own websites; they are not products or content created by {{appName}}.
